items.title: Software Defined Networks Key Relay for Large-Scale Quantum Key Distribution Networks
items.summary: This work addresses the orchestration of large-scale Quantum Key Distribution Networks (QKDNs) using Software Defined Networking (SDN). Building on ETSI and ITU specifications, common best practices and architectures are outlined. The main task of the SDN Controller is to aggregate technical key performance indicators (KPI) from the network and, based on these, select the optimal path. Multiple path selection algorithms, based on Dijkstra or a maximum-minimum capacity algorithm, with built-in load balancing are presented. The algorithms were tested in simulations and their performances, and tradeoffs, are discussed. Additional critical aspects related to SDN controlled QKDNs are discussed, such as query batching, multi-path selection and group key capabilities. An oblivious multi-party protocol is proposed for relay path selection in a multi-domain scenario, so providers don't have to disclose sensitive information about their QKDN. These contributions aim to enhance scalability, resilience and interoperability in quantum-secure network infrastructures.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究面向大规模量子密钥分发网络（QKDN）的软件定义网络（SDN）编排问题。作者在ETSI和ITU标准规范的基础上，梳理了QKDN与SDN协同的通用最佳实践和架构参考。核心思路是将SDN控制器作为网络中的关键编排组件，负责聚合来自全网的技术性能指标（KPI），并基于这些指标为量子密钥分发业务选择最优路径。文中提出了多种路径选择算法，包括基于Dijkstra算法的变体以及一种最大-最小容量算法，并均内置了负载均衡机制。作者在仿真环境中对这些算法进行了测试，对比了不同算法在性能表现和权衡取舍方面的差异。此外，文章还讨论了SDN控制QKDN的其他关键方面，如查询批处理、多路径选择以及组密钥能力。针对多域场景下的中继路径选择问题，作者提出了一种不经意的多方计算协议，使得不同服务提供商在协作选择路径时无需披露各自QKDN的敏感内部信息。整体而言，这些贡献旨在提升量子安全网络基础设施的可扩展性、弹性和互操作性。适合从事量子网络、SDN控制器设计、密钥管理以及安全网络架构研究的人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 为QKD网络与SDN结合提供了系统性架构和算法设计，尤其是多域场景下的隐私保护路径选择方案，对构建大规模量子安全网络具有重要参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 面向未来量子安全网络基础设施，可迁移至SDN控制器、密钥中继路由、多域协作网络编排等场景，也可为ETSI/ITU标准实现提供借鉴。

items.why_it_matters: 为QKD网络与SDN结合提供了系统性架构和算法设计，尤其是多域场景下的隐私保护路径选择方案，对构建大规模量子安全网络具有重要参考价值。

items.title: TENET: Telegram Mini App (in)security
items.summary: Telegram, with over 450 million daily active users, has introduced Mini Apps---web-based applications running directly within its client. However, this integration introduces notable security risks. As we demonstrate, many Mini Apps store authentication materials---such as session tokens and wallet mnemonic phrases---in plaintext on client devices, exposing users to unauthorized access, impersonation, and financial exploitation. While insecure client-side storage is a known risk in web applications, the Telegram Mini App ecosystem presents a uniquely dangerous combination of factors absent from prior work: no platform-level security review, no storage access restrictions, a financially motivated user base handling live cryptocurrency assets, and a WebView environment that offers weaker protections than standalone browsers. To investigate this threat, we present TENET, a purpose-built auditing tool whose design decisions---pattern selection, entropy thresholds, and charset validation---are grounded in the structural properties of the secrets targeted and empirically validated against a ground-truth dataset. We screened 61 Mini Apps using a stratified, popularity-weighted sampling strategy based on popularity. Of the 37 applications that met our processing criteria and were analyzed, 30 exhibited security flaws, which we classify into three severity tiers: plaintext storage, recoverable encryption, and replayable tokens. Notably, even Telegram's official Wallet exhibits a severe vulnerability that may lead to full account compromise. Following our responsible disclosure, Telegram implemented two new secure-storage APIs, and our post-remediation verification confirmed that its official Wallet no longer exposes the recovery mnemonic in plaintext. Finally, we propose mitigation measures and best practices for both Telegram platform developers and third-party Mini App creators.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究了Telegram Mini App生态系统的安全隐患。Telegram拥有超过4.5亿日活跃用户，其Mini App是运行在客户端内的Web应用，但集成方式引入了显著安全风险。研究表明，许多Mini App将认证材料（如会话令牌和钱包助记词）以明文形式存储在客户端设备上，导致用户面临未授权访问、身份冒用和财务损失。该生态系统的独特危险组合包括：缺乏平台级安全审查、无存储访问限制、用户群体涉及真实加密货币资产，以及WebView环境比独立浏览器防护更弱。作者提出了TENET——一个专门构建的审计工具，其设计决策（模式选择、熵阈值、字符集验证）基于目标秘密的结构属性，并通过真实数据集进行了经验验证。他们采用基于流行度的分层抽样策略筛选了61个Mini App，其中37个满足处理条件并完成分析，30个存在安全缺陷，按严重程度分为三类：明文存储、可恢复加密和可重放令牌。特别值得注意的是，Telegram官方Wallet存在严重漏洞，可能导致账户完全被接管。经过负责任披露，Telegram实施了两个新的安全存储API，复验确认官方Wallet不再明文暴露恢复助记词。最后，作者为Telegram平台开发者和第三方Mini App创作者提出了缓解措施和最佳实践。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: Telegram Mini App涉及大量加密资产用户，且平台缺乏安全审查，审计发现多数应用存在高危漏洞，直接影响用户资金安全，蓝队需关注此类WebView集成风险。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响Telegram Mini App生态，特别是涉及加密货币钱包的应用；方法可迁移到其他内嵌WebView平台（如其他聊天应用的小程序）的安全审计。
detection_signals_zh: 客户端明文存储会话令牌或助记词等敏感信息
WebView环境中的存储API滥用或缺乏访问控制
可重放的认证令牌或弱加密密钥
defense_advice_zh: 使用安全存储API（如Telegram新提供）而非明文或弱加密存储
对Mini App进行强制安全审查和存储访问权限控制
对用户敏感数据实施加密保护，并确保密钥管理安全

items.title: SoK: Cross-Chain Transaction Identification and Matching
items.summary: Cross-chain bridges, instant cryptocurrency exchanges, and centralized cross-ledger platforms move assets across an increasingly multi-chain ecosystem. However, these systems have repeatedly become targets of high-value attacks and channels for cross-chain money laundering. Cross-chain transactions are substantially harder to analyze than single-chain transactions: no single ledger records an entire cross-chain transfer, its evidence is scattered across the source chain, the destination chain, and off-chain systems, and the availability and reliability of that evidence vary widely across systems. In this paper, we present a systematization of knowledge (SoK) on cross-chain transaction identification and matching. First, we classify deposit and withdrawal identification methods into four approaches and transaction matching methods into three mechanisms: deterministic identifier matching, field-constraint heuristics, and model-assisted matching. We find that their applicability and reported performance are shaped mainly by the evidence the underlying system exposes, and we further examine how matched pairs support downstream attack detection and fund tracing. Second, we assess the availability of existing datasets and artifacts, finding that fewer than half remain obtainable, and distill three artifact failure modes. Finally, we outline four open challenges toward auditable, reproducible, and actionable cross-chain analysis.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文是一篇关于跨链交易识别与匹配的系统化知识（SoK）综述。研究背景是跨链桥、即时加密货币交易所和中心化跨账本平台等机制在多链生态中频繁转移资产，但这些系统屡屡成为高价值攻击的目标，也被用作跨链洗钱的渠道。与单链交易不同，跨链交易没有单一账本记录完整转账过程，其证据分散在源链、目标链和链下系统中，且不同系统暴露的证据可用性和可靠性差异很大，使得跨链交易分析极具挑战。论文的核心贡献包括：首先，将存款和取款识别方法划分为四类，将交易匹配方法归纳为三种机制，即确定性标识符匹配、字段约束启发式和模型辅助匹配；作者指出这些方法的适用性和报告性能主要受底层系统暴露的证据形态影响，并分析了匹配后的交易对如何支持下游攻击检测和资金追踪。其次，论文对现有公开数据集和工具工件进行了可用性评估，发现超过一半的工件已无法获取，并总结出三种典型的工件失效模式。最后，论文提出了四个开放挑战，旨在推动跨链分析走向可审计、可复现、可操作。该综述为跨链交易取证、攻击归因和反洗钱分析提供了系统化的分类框架与实用评估，适合区块链安全研究者、威胁情报分析师和加密货币取证人员深入阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 跨链攻击和洗钱是现实威胁，但分析工具和研究碎片化。该SoK首次系统梳理识别与匹配方法，为防御者提供了清晰的分类和现有工具可用性评估，有助于选择合适方法并理解局限。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响跨链安全分析工具的设计，匹配方法可迁移到攻击检测、资金追踪和反洗钱场景。但具体影响面取决于后续研究验证。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 建议安全团队阅读该SoK，评估匹配方法在自身取证流程中的适用性，并关注后续数据集发布。

items.title: CryptDough: A Unified Analytics Engine for Secure Multiparty Computation
items.summary: We present CryptDough, a unified analytics engine for secure multiparty computation (MPC). CryptDough enables multiple distrusting parties to jointly execute a data analysis pipeline on their private inputs and learn nothing beyond the result (e.g., aggregate statistics). Unlike existing MPC solutions that support a single threat model or workload type, CryptDough provides built-in support for cross-domain analytics (relational, time series, ML inference) under various threat models, all within the same system runtime. CryptDough contributes (i) a hierarchical system design that facilitates modularity and extensibility through progressive lowering of abstractions, and (ii) the concept of virtual vectors that enable users to write single-threaded code across all layers of the software stack, while pushing the complexity of communication, parallelization, and memory management down to the execution engine. We show that CryptDough generalizes the functionality of state-of-the-art MPC systems and remains competitive on the analytics they support, often outperforming them by more than $2\times$.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CryptDough 是一个面向安全多方计算（MPC）的统一分析引擎，旨在解决现有 MPC 系统只能支持单一威胁模型或单一工作负载类型的问题。论文提出了一种分层系统设计，通过渐进式抽象降低实现模块化与可扩展性，使得同一运行时能够同时支持关系分析、时间序列分析和机器学习推理等跨域分析任务，并兼容多种威胁模型。核心创新是“虚拟向量”（virtual vectors）概念，允许用户在整个软件栈的各层使用单线程代码编写程序，而将通信、并行化和内存管理的复杂性下推到执行引擎中。实验表明，CryptDough 能够泛化现有最先进 MPC 系统的功能，并在其支持的分析任务上保持竞争力，通常可实现超过 2 倍的性能提升。该论文主要面向系统研究者、隐私保护计算开发者以及需要在实际部署中支持多种 MPC 工作负载的安全工程师。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究为 MPC 系统提供统一架构，降低了跨领域隐私计算集成的复杂度，对需要同时支持多种分析任务和威胁模型的蓝队架构设计具有参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可能影响隐私增强计算（PEC）平台的架构设计，以及安全分析中涉及多方数据联合查询、联合建模等场景的工程实现。

items.title: Cross-Domain Joint DDoS Detection in Multi-Controller SDN via Confidence-Based Entropy Fusion
items.summary: In multi-controller Software-Defined Networking (SDN), Distributed Denial-of-Service (DDoS) attacks exhibit a "dispersed source, concentrated target" pattern across domains, i.e., attack traffic originates from multiple edge-controller domains but converges on a victim in a single aggregation controller domain. While entropy-based DDoS detectors are effective in single-controller settings, their direct application in multi-controller SDN reveals a previously overlooked anomaly. Through systematic experiments, we identify an aggregation bias: during the post-attack transition phase, the aggregation controller continues to generate excessive false positives, while edge controllers have already returned to normal. We attribute this phenomenon to the coupled effects of OpenFlow statistics lag and unconstrained dynamic-threshold drift. To address this issue, we propose a cross-domain confidence-fusion framework that leverages lightweight edge-side messages to calibrate aggregation-controller decisions without sharing raw traffic data. The framework is non-intrusive, communication-efficient, and incrementally deployable. Experiments on a three-controller linear Mininet testbed with 24 hosts over 10 runs show that the method preserves edge-controller performance while reducing the aggregation false positive rate from 8.87% to 1.96% and increasing the F1 score from 89.04% to 96.89%.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对多控制器软件定义网络（SDN）中分布式拒绝服务（DDoS）攻击的跨域检测问题展开研究。在多控制器SDN架构下，DDoS攻击呈现“分散源、集中目标”的模式，即攻击流量源自多个边缘控制器域，但最终汇聚到单一聚合控制器域中的受害目标。已有的基于熵的DDoS检测器在单控制器场景下表现良好，但直接应用于多控制器环境时出现了一个此前被忽视的异常现象：在攻击后的过渡阶段，聚合控制器持续产生大量误报，而边缘控制器已恢复正常。作者通过系统性实验将该现象归因于OpenFlow统计信息滞后与无约束动态阈值漂移的耦合效应。为解决该问题，论文提出了一种基于置信度融合的跨域检测框架，该框架利用轻量级的边缘侧消息来校准聚合控制器的决策，而无需共享原始流量数据。该框架具有非侵入性、通信高效且可增量部署的特点。实验在包含24台主机、三控制器线性拓扑的Mininet测试平台上进行，共运行10次，结果表明该方法在保持边缘控制器性能不变的同时，将聚合控制器的误报率从8.87%降低至1.96%，F1分数从89.04%提升至96.89%。本文适合SDN安全、入侵检测及分布式系统安全方向的研究人员与工程师阅读，其核心贡献在于揭示并解决了多控制器环境下熵检测的聚合偏差问题，提出了一种实用的跨域协作检测方案。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 首次揭示多控制器SDN中熵检测器在跨域场景下的聚合偏差问题，并给出轻量级融合解决方案，对提升SDN整体抗DDoS能力具有直接价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响多控制器SDN架构下的DDoS检测准确性，可迁移至其他分布式网络监控场景，如跨域流量分析、边缘-核心协同检测。
detection_signals_zh: 聚合控制器在攻击后阶段仍持续产生高误报
OpenFlow统计信息滞后导致决策延迟
动态阈值漂移引起异常检测偏差
defense_advice_zh: 在多控制器SDN中部署跨域置信度融合机制，利用边缘侧轻量消息辅助聚合控制器决策。
监控OpenFlow统计信息的时效性，避免因滞后导致误报。
对动态阈值增加约束条件，防止无界漂移。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进：评估该跨域融合框架在自身SDN环境中的可部署性，并进行小规模验证。

items.title: KeyPooling: Measuring Where LLM API Relay Paths Collapse Prompt Cache Isolation
items.summary: Large language model (LLM) API relays authenticate customers separately but often forward requests through shared provider credentials. Providers scope prompt caches to upstream principals and namespaces, so relay customers mapped to one cache identity can observe each other's cache state. Prior work showed cache sharing at selected endpoints but did not identify which credential, pool, adapter, or nested hop controls the finalidentity. We present KeyPooling, a measurement method that traces customer identity through cache lookup and write, verifies runtime transformations, and tests one predicted identity component at a time. Across five open-source gateways connected to OpenAI and Anthropic, none bound customers to upstream credentials by default; under a shared credential, all five exposed cross-customer cache reads for both providers. Principal and namespace splits, pool associations, and adapter and nested-relay contrasts localized the controlling transformations. In an outcome-independent weekly OpenRouter frame, tests covered 80.5% of eligible token volume and found cross-account reads for 12 of 28 labels carrying 33.7% of volume. On one production route, a controlled procedure recovered eight consecutive target positions without target access. Broader tests identify cache granularity, routing, rate limits, attribution, and budget as conditions for token-by-token recovery, not security controls. We derive a defense contract: every customer must enter a provider-enforced domain, or a namespace derived from authenticated identity must survive every final cache lookup and write. Placing this split after reusable public prefixes preserved most modeled reuse at a 1.7-2.5% cost increase.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）API 中继服务通常对客户分别进行身份验证，但在转发请求时往往使用共享的提供商凭据。提供商将提示缓存（prompt cache）的范围限定到上游主体和命名空间，因此映射到同一缓存身份的中继客户可以观察到彼此的缓存状态。已有研究曾在选定端点上展示缓存共享现象，但未能确定具体是哪个凭据、池、适配器或多级跳转控制了最终身份。本文提出 KeyPooling，一种测量方法，通过缓存查找和写入追踪客户身份，验证运行时变换，并每次只测试一个预测的身份组件。在连接到 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 的五个开源网关中，默认情况下没有哪个网关将客户绑定到上游凭据；在共享凭据下，五个网关均暴露了跨客户缓存读取。主体与命名空间拆分、池关联、适配器及嵌套中继对比定位了控制变换。在与结果无关的每周 OpenRouter 框架中，测试覆盖了 80.5% 的合格令牌量，并发现 28 个标签中有 12 个存在跨账户读取，占 33.7% 的流量。在一条生产路由上，受控流程在不访问目标任务的情况下恢复了八个连续目标位置。更广泛的测试表明，缓存粒度、路由、速率限制、归属和预算等条件是逐令牌恢复的条件，而非安全控制措施。作者推导出一个防御契约：每个客户必须进入提供商强制执行的域，或者由经过身份验证的身份派生的命名空间必须存活于每次最终缓存查找和写入之中。将这一拆分置于可复用公共前缀之后，在 1.7% 到 2.5% 的成本增加下保留大部分建模复用。本文适合关注 LLM 供应链安全、API 网关设计及缓存隔离机制的蓝队成员、安全架构师与云安全研究人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭示 LLM API 中继普遍存在的缓存隔离失效问题，可能导致客户间提示数据泄露，直接影响使用 OpenAI/Anthropic 等服务的下游企业，属于新型侧信道风险。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有通过共享凭据连接 LLM 提供商的开源 API 网关用户；涉及 OpenRouter 等聚合平台，可能导致跨账户缓存读取、提示词恢复和令牌级信息泄露。
detection_signals_zh: 同一上游凭据下多个客户共享缓存键，导致缓存命中率异常
API 响应中缓存命中状态与请求账户身份不匹配
中继路由中命名空间或主体标识缺失或未传递
defense_advice_zh: 确保中继配置将每个客户映射到独立的上游凭据或命名空间
提供商侧强制实施基于认证身份的缓存隔离
对共享凭据的网关进行流量审计，监控缓存读取越权行为
部署可复用公共前缀后拆分器，在成本与安全之间取得平衡
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进：评估自身 LLM 中继架构是否存在缓存隔离风险，并测试供应商的缓存域配置。

items.title: Decomposition Attacks Across Unlinkable Identities: Limits of Stateful Defenses for LLM Services
items.summary: Most large language model services use stateless defenses, which judge only the current request, to refuse harmful tasks. Decomposition attacks exploit this limitation by splitting a harmful task into individually permissible requests and combining their answers. Defending against them therefore requires a stateful monitor that considers requests together. If it can group all requests for one attacker task, it can stop the attack. However, attackers can use unlinkable identities and combine answers elsewhere, leaving no reliable grouping signal. We ask whether decomposition attacks can still be stopped under this setting. For a fixed attack strategy without retries, we prove that the achievable security and utility tradeoff depends entirely on how benign requests for the same capabilities are grouped. Persistent, recognizable groups permit a useful defense; fresh, indistinguishable groups do not. When attackers can retry and learn from Allow/Block decisions, this useful operating point disappears: the feedback reveals what passes but not whether a block was correct. Experiments on 91 executable tasks and 11,393 capability-matched benign requests support these results. Under a 1% denial cap for these requests and a 0.5% cap for unrelated background traffic, all ten tested policies, including one privileged policy with an exact request-to-operation map, either fail to stop attacks or exceed the budget. On defense-unseen task families, attack success is at least 99% after one attempt and 100% after two. Effective defenses therefore require additional evidence or mechanisms tied to grouping, such as reliable identity linkage, costs for fresh identities, or control over answer use.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本研究针对大语言模型（LLM）服务中的分解攻击（Decomposition Attacks）展开，分析了在攻击者使用不可链接身份（unlinkable identities）时，状态化防御（stateful defenses）是否仍能有效阻止此类攻击。大多数LLM服务采用无状态防御，仅对当前请求做判断，攻击者可将有害任务拆分为多个单独合规的请求，随后组合答案。因此，防御需要状态化监控，将同一攻击任务的相关请求聚合。然而，攻击者可以通过不可链接身份在不同会话中发送请求，并在外部组合答案，破坏分组所需的关联信号。本文提出核心问题：在此场景下，分解攻击能否被阻止？作者首先从理论上证明：在无重试的固定攻击策略下，可达到的安全性与效用权衡完全取决于良性请求的分组特征——若良性请求可被持久识别分组，则存在有效防御；若每次请求都表现为新且不可区分的组，则防御失效。当攻击者能够重试并利用Allow/Block决策反馈进行学习时，这一有效工作点消失，因为反馈只能告知请求是否通过，而无法验证阻止决策是否正确。实验使用91个可执行任务和11,393个能力匹配的良性请求，在1%的良性请求拒绝上限和0.5%的不相关背景流量拒绝上限约束下，评估了十种测试策略（包括一种具备精确请求到操作映射的特权策略），结果所有策略要么无法阻止攻击，要么超出预算。在防御未见过的任务族上，攻击一次尝试成功率至少99%，两次后达100%。结论表明，现有依赖分组的防御机制在不可链接身份下存在根本性局限，有效防御需借助额外证据或机制，如可靠身份关联、对新鲜身份增加成本，或对答案使用进行控制。本研究为LLM安全防护提供了重要理论边界与实验证据，适合LLM服务提供商、安全研究人员和防御系统设计者参考。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 揭示了LLM服务在不可链接身份下对分解攻击的防御失效，提醒安全团队不能仅依赖请求分组或状态监控，需考虑身份管理与成本控制等额外机制。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有提供LLM服务并依赖无状态或简单状态化过滤的防护系统，尤其在攻击者使用多身份绕过时，现有防御可能导致高攻击成功率或过度拒绝良性请求。
defense_advice_zh: 引入可靠的身份关联机制，确保同一攻击者的请求可被有效分组
为新身份或账号创建增加成本，如验证、速率限制等
对敏感任务的组合答案进行二次审查，控制答案的使用
结合行为分析等额外证据，而非仅依赖请求分组
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进，并评估自身LLM服务对分解攻击的暴露程度

items.title: FESC: Remodeling Long-Context Private Inference with Encrypted State-Space Models
items.summary: Processing long, sensitive documents with machine-learning models requires efficient, privacy-preserving long-context inference. Prior private inference systems optimize or distribute encrypted Transformer attention, but its quadratic token-pair work remains the bottleneck as sequence length grows. Selective state-space models (SSMs) offer linear-time recurrence, yet direct encrypted implementation incurs linear multiplicative depth, sequence-wide state residency, or dense FHE-MPC conversion. We present Factorized Encrypted Scan-Contract (FESC), a hybrid FHE-MPC system for private long-context selective SSM inference. Its factorized scan-contract keeps input-dependent transitions compact across conversion boundaries, composes them without dense expansion, streams state chunks on demand, and contracts outputs before conversion. We demonstrate interface compatibility of the scan-contract implementation across invariant and selective SSM architectures. For our Mamba-2 instantiation, we design GPU-optimized CKKS kernels for linear computations, MPC protocols for SiLU, softplus, exponential, and RMSNorm, with approximation-aware fine-tuning. To our knowledge, FESC is the first private long-document inference system to complete native end-to-end execution at $L \geq 1{,}024$ on a single GPU. At $L = 2{,}048$, a 12-layer Mamba-base model completes inference in 77.3 minutes on one A100 GPU with a peak memory footprint of 32.7 GB, while maintaining near-plaintext accuracy on the evaluated long-document tasks.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出了一种名为FESC（Factorized Encrypted Scan-Contract）的混合FHE-MPC系统，用于实现对长上下文选择性状态空间模型（SSM）的隐私保护推理。研究背景是，处理长且敏感的文档时，需要高效且保护隐私的推理方法。现有的隐私推理系统主要优化或分布加密Transformer的注意力机制，但注意力机制中token两两计算量随序列长度呈二次方增长，成为瓶颈。选择性SSM（如Mamba）具有线性时间递归特性，为长上下文推理提供了新思路，但直接对SSM进行加密实现会带来线性乘法深度、全序列状态驻留或密集的FHE-MPC转换等问题。FESC通过因式分解的扫描-收缩方法，在转换边界保持输入相关的状态转换紧凑，避免密集展开，按需流式传输状态块，并在转换前收缩输出。该系统支持不变和选择性SSM架构的接口兼容性。针对Mamba-2实例，作者设计了GPU优化的CKKS内核用于线性计算，并利用MPC协议处理SiLU、softplus、指数函数和RMSNorm，同时引入近似感知微调以保持模型精度。实验表明，FESC是首个在单GPU上完成L>=1024长度的本地端到端隐私长文档推理系统。在L=2048时，一个12层Mamba-base模型在单块A100 GPU上以77.3分钟完成推理，峰值内存占用32.7 GB，且在评估的长文档任务上保持接近明文精度的表现。这项工作为长上下文隐私推理提供了新的技术路线，适合对隐私计算、高效机器学习和同态加密交叉领域感兴趣的研究者和工程人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 长上下文隐私推理是实际应用中的迫切需求，本方法突破序列长度限制，以线性复杂度替代二次复杂度，大幅提升效率，为安全处理超长文档提供了可行方案。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可应用于医疗记录、法律文档、金融报告等长文档的隐私分析场景，也可推动SSM模型在安全ML服务中的落地。

items.title: On the Pseudo-Mixing of Kac's Walk
items.summary: Motivated by a conjecture of Vaikuntanathan and Zamir, we study the pseudo-mixing of Kac's walk on $\mathrm{SO}(n)$: whether short trajectories are indistinguishable from Haar measure by low-complexity tests. We prove that the first $k$ columns mix in Wasserstein distance in $O(n(k+\log n)\log n)$ steps for fixed accuracy, resolving a conjecture of Oliveira. Combining this with a representation-theoretic variance bound, we show that if $T=ω(nk(k+\log n)\log n)$, then every degree-$k$ polynomial normalized to have unit Haar variance has expectation under the $T$-step law within $o(1)$ of its Haar expectation. As an application, we show that this pseudo-mixing estimate can be used to prove the effectiveness of a fast Johnson--Lindenstrauss transform with the usual target dimension.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究 Kac 游走在 SO(n) 上的伪混合性质，该问题由 Vaikuntanathan 和 Zamir 的猜想所启发。伪混合关注的是：短时间演化后的分布是否能让低复杂度的测试者无法与 Haar 测度区分。作者首先证明了前 k 列在 Wasserstein 距离下，对于固定精度，经过 O(n(k+log n) log n) 步即可达到混合，从而解决了 Oliveira 的一个猜想。然后结合表示论中的方差界，证明了更强的结论：若步数 T = ω(n k (k + log n) log n)，则任意单位 Haar 方差归一化的 k 次多项式在 T 步后的期望与 Haar 期望相差 o(1)。这一结果实质性地刻画了 Kac 游走的伪混合速度。作为应用，作者展示了该伪混合估计可用于证明快速 Johnson-Lindenstrauss 变换在通常目标维度下的有效性。该论文属于概率论与机器学习理论的交叉研究，其数学工具涵盖马尔可夫链收敛分析、表示论以及高维几何。主要贡献在于给出了伪混合的定量估计，并为随机化算法中的伪随机性提供了理论基础。适合理论计算机科学、概率论与机器学习领域的研究者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究为随机化算法中的伪随机性提供了严谨的数学保证，尤其对 Johnson-Lindenstrauss 变换等高效降维方法的可靠性有理论支撑。安全领域中对随机数生成和差分隐私等应用亦有参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响局限于理论层面，但可为设计可证明安全的随机化算法和密码学原语提供数学基础。

items.why_it_matters: 该研究为随机化算法中的伪随机性提供了严谨的数学保证，尤其对 Johnson-Lindenstrauss 变换等高效降维方法的可靠性有理论支撑。安全领域中对随机数生成和差分隐私等应用亦有参考价值。

items.title: Trusted Workflow Relays:Cross-Tenant Email Abuse and Composable Red Team Initial-Access Primitives in Multi-Tenant Clouds
items.summary: Cloud applications routinely send notifications through provider-operated mail identities, which improves deliverability but separates the actor who supplies notification parameters from the service principal that originates the message. In three responsibly disclosed and remediated cross-tenant notification workflows, an authenticated actor could reach recipients across tenant boundaries and, to varying degrees, control content that a trusted provider service delivered. In the first, backend requests bypassed a UI length limit, raw HTML and CSS survived into the delivered message, attacker links rendered, and CSS could hide service-controlled text; iframes and non-web URI schemes were rejected. The second combined missing recipient-tenant validation with attacker-controlled subject and HTML fields. The third, an approval application, added weak access control, sequential object identifiers, missing action authorization, and incomplete token validation, composing notification abuse with authorization failures. The pattern is analogous to a classical unauthenticated SMTP open relay, but the failure has moved up the stack: the actor is authenticated and the provider is the legitimate sender, yet application-layer authorization still fails to constrain who may cause it to send what to whom. We define a trusted workflow relay as a delivered, service-authentic message for which the application-level send-authorization predicate is false. We give a test matrix for notification pipelines, map the primitive to MITRE ATT&CK techniques for attachment-free phishing, and link it to device-code phishing (RFC 8628). SPF, DKIM, and DMARC can authenticate a message yet cannot establish that an application-level send was authorized. We conclude with controls for tenant binding, typed templates, object-level authorization, token audience validation, and identity telemetry.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究多租户云应用中跨租户通知工作流存在的授权缺陷，这些缺陷可被利用来冒充受信任的提供商服务发送电子邮件。作者将这种模式定义为“可信工作流中继”（Trusted Workflow Relay），类比于经典的未认证SMTP开放中继，但已有区别：攻击者是经过身份验证的合法用户，而消息由提供商服务自身发送，问题在于应用层的发送授权谓词未得到正确执行。通过三个负责披露并已修复的漏洞案例，作者展示了攻击者如何跨越租户边界，控制受信任服务发送的消息内容。第一个案例中，后端请求绕过了UI长度限制，原始HTML和CSS被注入到发送的邮件中，可隐藏服务控制文本，但iframe和非常规URI方案被拒绝。第二个案例结合了缺少收件人租户验证与攻击者可控的subject和HTML字段。第三个案例是一个审批应用，存在弱访问控制、顺序对象标识符、缺失操作授权和不完整令牌验证，将通知滥用与授权失败组合在一起。作者为通知管道提供了测试矩阵，将利用手法映射到MITRE ATT&CK中的无附件钓鱼技术，并关联到RFC 8628的设备码钓鱼。他们指出，SPF、DKIM和DMARC能够验证消息身份，却无法证明应用层发送已获得授权。最后，文章提出了租户绑定、类型化模板、对象级授权、令牌受众验证和身份遥测等控制措施。该论文适合云服务提供商、安全平台工程师和红队人员阅读，用于评估和加固通知工作流的安全边界。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 云应用普遍使用通知邮件，此类跨租户中继缺陷可导致钓鱼攻击和初始访问，且信任提供商身份使防御更困难。研究揭示的授权验证盲区值得云安全工程师重视。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响多租户云应用的通知管道，可被用于跨租户钓鱼、信任滥用；类似模式可迁移到其他云服务及企业协同工具。
detection_signals_zh: 监控来自受信任提供商服务的邮件中是否包含异常HTML或CSS内容
关注审批类应用发送的意外邮件或接收者与租户不匹配
检查令牌验证失败或访问控制异常事件
关注身份遥测中发送者与接收者租户关系是否异常
defense_advice_zh: 实施严格的租户绑定，确保消息接收方与发起方租户匹配
使用类型化模板，限制用户可控字段对消息内容的影响
对通知操作实施对象级授权（Object-Level Authorization）
验证令牌受众（audience）和租户上下文，防止跨租户滥用
建立身份遥测，跟踪邮件发送的授权链和异常模式

items.title: Fair ASR: Re-Evaluating Black-Box Jailbreaks under Shared Target-Call Budgets
items.summary: Reliable jailbreak evaluation is essential for assessing LLM safety, but most existing studies rely solely on attack success rate (ASR) without accounting for its dependence on attack budgets, resulting in unfair comparisons across methods. Existing compute-aware evaluations reduce heterogeneous resources into FLOPs, which is difficult to estimate for black-box models and fails to capture resource-specific constraints. To provide a comparable evaluation basis, we introduce Fair-ASR, an evaluation protocol for black-box jailbreak attacks under shared target-call budgets B, using target calls as a directly observable and method-agnostic comparison axis while tracking attacker calls separately for efficiency analysis. We re-evaluate 11 representative attacks under the Fair-ASR protocol and find that attack rankings change substantially across target-call budgets, simple stochastic perturbations and hand-crafted templates remain highly competitive under equal target access, and no evaluated LLM-driven method is efficient in both target and attacker calls. Motivated by this efficiency gap, we introduce ReCode, a compositional budget-efficient attack that combines desensitization rewriting with two effective low-cost primitives identified by Fair-ASR. Under a budget of 20 target calls, ReCode achieves 85% ASR on GPT-5 while requiring only 7.19 attacker calls per request on average, showing strong efficiency in both target and attacker calls.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对大语言模型（LLM）安全评估中黑盒越狱攻击评测不公平的问题，提出了名为 Fair-ASR 的新型评估协议。当前大多数研究仅使用攻击成功率（ASR）作为衡量指标，忽视攻击预算对结果的影响，导致不同方法之间的比较不公平。已有的计算感知评估方法尝试将异构资源统一折算为 FLOPs，但对黑盒模型而言 FLOPs 难以估计，且无法体现资源特有的约束。为此，Fair-ASR 采用共享目标调用预算 B 作为统一、可直接观测且与具体方法无关的比较基准，同时单独记录攻击者的调用次数以进行效率分析。作者在 Fair-ASR 协议下重新评估了 11 种代表性攻击方法，发现攻击排名在不同目标调用预算下会发生显著变化；简单随机扰动和手工构造模板在同等目标访问权限下仍极具竞争力；而所评估的基于 LLM 的攻击方法没有任何一种在目标调用和攻击者调用两方面都高效。针对这一效率缺口，作者进一步提出了 ReCode，一种组合式预算高效攻击方法，将脱敏改写与 Fair-ASR 识别出的两种低成本高效原语结合。在 20 次目标调用的预算下，ReCode 在 GPT-5 上实现了 85% 的 ASR，且每个请求平均仅需 7.19 次攻击者调用，展示了在目标调用和攻击者调用两个维度上的强效率。该工作为黑盒越狱攻击评测提供了更公平的基准，并为构建更高效的攻击方法提供了新思路，适合 LLM 安全研究者、红队测评人员及模型提供商参考。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 现有越狱评估多只看 ASR，忽略预算差异，导致结论失真。Fair-ASR 引入公平比较协议，对安全评测方法论有直接改进价值，并揭示了高效攻击的新设计空间。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响 LLM 安全评测实践，可迁移至越狱防御评估、红队工具选型及模型鲁棒性基准测试等场景。

items.title: FlowShield: cryptocurrency anti-money laundering with transaction semantics parsing and fund flow tracking
items.summary: Cryptocurrency anti-money laundering (Crypto AML) is increasingly challenged by sophisticated laundering behaviors that rapidly fragment stolen assets through diverse semantics and across multiple blockchains. Existing Crypto AML methods often simplify transaction semantics, rely on topology-centric signals, or output isolated detection labels. In this paper, we present \textsc{FlowShield}, a Crypto AML framework for transaction-level laundering detection and investigator-facing report generation. \textsc{FlowShield} first recovers behavior-level semantics from observable relations, making laundering intents explicit. To trace value provenance and redistribution, \textsc{FlowShield} reconstructs fund-flow subgraphs from three complementary perspectives. It then employs a text--structure fusion mechanism, enabling the interplay between large language model (LLM)-encoded semantics and flow texts with graph convolutional network (GCN)-encoded structure. Beyond mere detection, \textsc{FlowShield} further generates readable suspicious activity reports (SARs), offering investigators concise summaries and explainable red flags. To address the data scarcity in multi-chain detection, we construct and open-source \textit{BybitML}, the first public multi-chain laundering dataset. We evaluate \textsc{FlowShield} on \textit{BybitML} and two public laundering datasets and experimental results demonstrate that \textsc{FlowShield} achieves the best overall performance, with an average F1 score of 98.0\%. Further behavior and SAR analyses demonstrate that \textsc{FlowShield} can reveal diverse laundering strategies and produce readable reports for investigating complex multi-hop fund flows.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出 FlowShield，一个面向加密货币反洗钱（Crypto AML）的框架，旨在解决现有方法在交易语义简化、依赖拓扑中心信号以及输出孤立检测标签等方面的不足。FlowShield 首先从可观察关系中恢复行为级语义，使洗钱意图显式化；接着从三个互补视角重构资金流子图，以追踪价值来源与再分配路径；然后采用文本-结构融合机制，将大语言模型（LLM）编码的语义与图卷积网络（GCN）编码的结构进行交互。除检测外，FlowShield 还能生成可读的疑似活动报告（SAR），为调查人员提供简洁摘要和可解释的警示标志。为解决多链检测数据稀缺问题，作者构建并开源了 BybitML——首个公开的多链洗钱数据集。实验在 BybitML 和两个公开洗钱数据集上进行，结果显示 FlowShield 综合性能最优，平均 F1 分数达 98.0%。进一步的行为和 SAR 分析表明，FlowShield 能揭示多样的洗钱策略，并为复杂的多跳资金流调查生成可读报告。该研究的主要贡献包括：提出行为级语义恢复方法、多视角资金流子图重构、文本-结构融合机制、自动生成 SAR 报告，以及开源多链数据集。适合从事区块链安全、AML 系统研发和智能合约分析的研究人员与安全工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 加密货币洗钱手法日趋复杂，跨链和语义混淆给传统 AML 检测带来挑战。FlowShield 融合 LLM 与 GCN，提供更可解释的检测与报告生成能力，对蓝队追踪恶意资金流动具有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于交易所风控、链上监控系统、执法调查辅助，以及多链资产追踪场景。其开源数据集 BybitML 可促进后续研究。

items.title: When Agents Act on Web3: An Attack-Surface Survey of MCP, Skills, and Tool Calling
items.summary: AI agents increasingly act rather than merely read: across the Model Context Protocol (MCP) ecosystem, the share of deployed tools that modify external state has risen from 27% to 65% of tool use. When agents exercise this authority on public blockchains through MCP, skills, and tool calling, the consequences of an attack are governed by the blockchain execution layer rather than by conventional software assumptions. This survey argues that four properties of that layer (irreversibility, signing authority, continuous autonomy, and sequence-level composition) qualitatively change the threat model, turning the recoverable failures of generic agent security into a standing, irreversible loss. We organize the fragmented MCP-security literature into an attack-surface taxonomy, then contribute a Web3 risk-mapping matrix that ties each attack class to its amplified impact, the responsible amplifiers, a representative mitigation, and the residual gap. We synthesize defenses, including emerging blockchain-based mechanisms, and find them improving but insufficient: measured protections stop fewer than 30% of attacks, and model-level safety refuses fewer than 3%. We close by positioning the work against adjacent surveys and deriving a research agenda from the matrix's open cells.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文是一篇针对 Web3 环境中 AI 智能体攻击面的综述性研究。随着 AI 智能体从单纯的读取数据转向实际执行操作，在模型上下文协议（MCP）生态系统中，能够修改外部状态的工具占比已从 27% 上升至 65%。当这些智能体通过 MCP、技能（skills）和工具调用在公共区块链上行使操作权限时，攻击后果由区块链执行层决定，而非传统软件假设。论文指出区块链执行层的四个关键属性——不可逆性、签名权限、持续自主性以及序列级组合——从根本上改变了威胁模型，将通用智能体安全中的可恢复性故障转变为一种持久性的、不可逆的损失。作者整理了碎片化的 MCP 安全文献，建立了一个攻击面分类体系，并提出了一个 Web3 风险映射矩阵，将每类攻击与其放大后的影响、责任放大器、代表性缓解措施及残余缺口相关联。综述还综合了各类防御手段，包括新兴的基于区块链的机制，评估结果表明这些防御措施虽有所改进但仍显不足：实测防护仅能阻止不到 30% 的攻击，而模型级安全措施拒绝的尝试不到 3%。最后，论文将自身工作与邻近综述进行对比，并基于矩阵中未解决的空白提出了研究议程。该研究适合关注 AI 智能体安全、区块链安全以及两者交叉领域的安全研究人员、区块链开发者及 LLM 应用设计者阅读，有助于理解 Web3 环境下智能体攻击面的独特风险与当前防御能力的短板。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 为理解 AI 智能体在区块链上执行操作时的独特威胁模型提供了系统性框架，揭示当前防御措施的严重不足，是指导和推动智能体安全领域研究的关键参考。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 研究成果可迁移至所有涉及区块链上 AI 智能体自主操作的场景，包括 DeFi、供应链管理、数字资产管理等，其攻击面分类与风险映射矩阵可用于指导安全评估与防御设计。

items.title: ADAPTD: Adaptive Detection and Proactive Threat Defense for Autonomous APT attacks
items.summary: Advanced persistent threat (APT) actors increasingly employ sophisticated techniques to propagate laterally through segmented enterprise networks. Timely detection and defense depend on cross-subnetwork coordination, yet maintaining global situational awareness generates substantial communication overhead. To manage this tradeoff, flexible monitoring and adaptable containment are imperative. This paper presents ADAPTD, a communication- and computation-efficient, decision-theoretic framework integrating: (i) compact kill chains for identifying diverse attack vectors, (ii) an immediate blocking mechanism for timely containment, and (iii) a predictive eviction strategy to restore system security. Our experiments validate ADAPTD's effectiveness across diverse threat scenarios. First, our decentralized belief update scheme outperforms state-of-the-art diffusion HMM. Second, ADAPTD substantially reduces false evictions compared to transformer-based detection. Third, under noisy environments, adaptive blocking contains attackers while minimizing unnecessary disruption. Lastly, the ablation study confirms that combining two defensive actions significantly reduces the defender's total cost.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 高级持续性威胁（APT）攻击者越来越善于利用复杂技术在企业网络中进行横向移动，跨越多个子网。及时检测和防御此类攻击需要跨子网的协调，但维护全局态势感知会产生显著的通信开销。为在检测能力与通信效率之间取得平衡，本文提出ADAPTD，一种通信和计算高效的、基于决策论的防御框架。ADAPTD集成三个核心组件：第一，紧凑的杀伤链模型，用于刻画和识别多种攻击向量，减少检测所需的全局信息依赖；第二，即时阻断机制，能够在检测到威胁时迅速采取遏制措施，降低攻击者的活动空间；第三，预测性驱逐策略，基于对攻击者后续行为的预测，主动将可疑主机或节点从网络中驱逐，以恢复系统安全。实验验证表明：ADAPTD的去中心化信念更新方案在检测性能上优于最先进的扩散隐马尔可夫模型；相比基于Transformer的检测方法，ADAPTD显著减少了误驱逐（即错误地将正常节点驱逐）的发生；在噪声环境下，自适应阻断机制能有效遏制攻击者，同时最小化对正常业务的不必要干扰；消融研究进一步证明，将阻断与驱逐两种防御动作组合使用可大幅降低防御者的总成本。该框架为企业分段网络的APT防御提供了一种新的决策理论方法，在检测准确性、通信开销和系统可用性之间实现了良好权衡。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 企业网络分段场景下，APT横向移动的检测与防御常面临通信开销与全局态势感知的矛盾。ADAPTD以决策论统筹检测、阻断和驱逐，显著降低误驱逐风险，为蓝队设计高效、低开销的APT防御机制提供新思路。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于需要跨子网协调检测的企业网络，尤其是对通信成本敏感的环境。其去中心化信念更新和自适应阻断思想可迁移到其它分布式入侵检测系统。
detection_signals_zh: 去中心化信念更新产生的异常评分
横向移动路径与紧凑杀伤链的匹配
误驱逐率对比正常行为的偏差
defense_advice_zh: 采用分层防御：即时阻断与预测性驱逐结合，平衡遏制效果与业务连续性
部署去中心化检测机制以减少全局通信开销，同时保持检测准确性

items.title: COMIC: Reference-Aware Safety Gating for Multimodal Large Language Models
items.summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly used to interact with screenshots, scanned documents, diagrams, and other visually grounded inputs. This shift introduces a new safety risk: in many multimodal jailbreaks, neither the prompt nor the image is harmful in isolation. Unsafe behavior emerges only when the model binds an apparently benign operation, such as summarizing, translating, or following, to a localized visual target. This reveals a structural weakness in current multimodal defenses, which largely moderate the prompt-image pair as a whole even though the true security-relevant unit is the grounded operation-target pair produced during dereference. In this work, we identify and analyze this reference-dependent failure mode and show that existing defenses degrade when harmful semantics are localized, activated only after grounding, and dependent on visual reference resolution. To address this problem, we propose COMIC (Context-Operation-Modality-Image-Classifier), a reference-aware pre-generation safety gate for MLLMs. COMIC first infers the requested operation and reference type, constructs candidate targets from OCR and open-vocabulary proposals, grounds plausible referents, and evaluates safety over explicit operation-target pairs. To handle ambiguity conservatively, COMIC combines max-risk aggregation with quality-aware routing before deciding whether to forward or block a request. We evaluate COMIC across multiple open-source MLLMs, localized and broader multimodal jailbreak benchmarks, and benign reference-sensitive settings. The results show that COMIC consistently improves robustness while preserving benign utility and practical efficiency. More broadly, our findings suggest that multimodal safety cannot be enforced reliably without modeling the requested operation, the visual target to which it applies, and the confidence of that grounding.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在视觉定位场景下出现的新型安全风险展开研究。作者指出，在许多多模态越狱攻击中，单看提示词或单看图像都不包含有害内容，但当模型将看似无害的操作（如总结、翻译、跟随指令）绑定到图像中的局部区域时，才会产生不安全行为。这种“引用依赖”的失败模式暴露了现有防御的结构性弱点：当前防御大多将提示-图像对作为整体进行审核，而真正需要审查的安全单元是模型在解引用（dereference）过程中产生的“操作-目标”绑定对。为了应对这一问题，作者提出了 COMIC（Context-Operation-Modality-Image-Classifier），一种引用感知的预生成安全门控机制。COMIC 首先推断请求的操作类型和引用类型，然后通过 OCR 和开放词汇建议构建候选目标，对可能的指代对象进行定位，最后针对显式的操作-目标对进行安全性评估。为了保守地处理歧义，COMIC 在决定放行或阻断请求前，结合了最大风险聚合和质量感知路由策略。作者在多个开源 MLLM、局部和更广泛的多模态越狱基准以及良性引用敏感场景上评估了 COMIC。结果表明，COMIC 在保持良性可用性和实际效率的同时，持续提升了鲁棒性。更广泛地，该研究提示多模态安全不能仅靠整体审核，必须对请求的操作、操作所指向的视觉目标以及该定位的置信度进行建模。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 现有多模态防御大多整体审核提示-图像对，忽略操作-目标绑定这一安全关键单元，导致局部化有害语义可绕过。COMIC 提出引用感知的安全门控，为构建鲁棒多模态防护提供了新方向，值得安全与 AI 系统设计者关注。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有依赖多模态大模型的场景，如截图分析、文档处理、图表理解等。其防御思路可迁移至视觉问答、具身智能等需要视觉指代解析的系统。
detection_signals_zh: 对提示词与图像各自无害、但组合后产生越狱行为的请求进行监控
跟踪模型内部是否对局部视觉区域产生了操作绑定（如OCR区域与总结指令）
使用引用感知的安全分类器评估操作-目标对的最大风险
defense_advice_zh: 在模型生成前引入引用感知的安全门控，显式建模操作与视觉目标
对多模态请求采用保守的最大风险聚合，避免因目标定位模糊而漏判
结合OCR和开放词汇建议提高目标候选的覆盖度，并评估定位置信度
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进，评估COMIC在自身多模态应用中的适用性，并考虑纳入内部安全评估框架

items.title: PACE: Policy-Attested Contract Execution for Safe AI Agents in Decentralized Finance
items.summary: Autonomous AI agents are emerging as interfaces for decentralized finance (DeFi) actions such as swaps, lending operations, and yield management. Because these agents rely on large language models (LLMs) to plan transactions, they inherit the LLM's susceptibility to prompt injection and lack of mechanisms to bind a verifier's approval to the exact transaction ultimately submitted on-chain. We present PACE (Policy-Attested Contract Execution), a transaction-level authorization framework that interposes between an LLM-based agent and on-chain execution. PACE introduces typed transaction intents, a deterministic policy verifier, and signed Policy Decision Records (PDRs) that cryptographically bind the approved intent, policy, and simulation report to the exact execution bytes, with replay and expiration protection. A Solidity smart account enforces PDR signatures on-chain with a measured overhead of 29,826-31,822 gas. We evaluate PACE against six baselines on 40 tasks spanning four attack categories plus benign utility (2,800 trials, 10 seeds). In our deterministic sandbox, PACE achieves a 0.00 unsafe execution rate and 0.00 false-positive rate on benign tasks, compared to 0.80 for the unguarded baseline. Ablation studies identify permissive policy settings (+57.5 pp) and the touched-contract allowlist (+12.5 pp) as the dominant safety components. To test whether the same deterministic floor holds for real model outputs, the artifact additionally provides a three-model live-LLM evaluation over the full task suite with repeated runs. A mainnet-fork harness is included for archive-RPC deployments, but fork results are reported only when the corresponding artifacts are generated. These auxiliary studies are separate from, and never substitute for, the deterministic benchmark. We frame our claims as logic-level safety within a reproducible benchmark rather than deployment-ready DeFi security.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出 PACE（Policy-Attested Contract Execution），一种面向去中心化金融（DeFi）场景中基于大语言模型（LLM）的自主代理的交易级授权框架。研究背景是：LLM 代理被用于执行 DeFi 操作（如交换、借贷、收益管理），但其规划交易的过程容易受到提示注入攻击，且缺乏将验证者的批准与最终上链的确切交易进行强绑定的机制。PACE 在 LLM 代理与链上执行之间插入一个交易级授权层，引入类型化交易意图、确定性策略验证器以及签名的策略决策记录（PDR）。PDR 通过密码学方式将已批准的意图、策略和模拟报告与确切的执行字节绑定，并包含重放和过期保护。在链上，一个 Solidity 智能账户强制执行 PDR 签名，实测开销为 29,826–31,822 gas。作者在 40 个任务（覆盖四类攻击场景及良性工具使用，共 2,800 次试验、10 个随机种子）上对比了 PACE 与六个基线。在确定性沙箱中，PACE 实现了 0.00 的不安全执行率和 0.00 的良性任务误报率，而未加防护的基线不安全率为 0.80。消融研究表明，宽松的策略设置（+57.5 个百分点）和接触合约白名单（+12.5 个百分点）是主要的安全组件。为检验确定性下限是否适用于真实模型输出，论文还提供了三个模型的实时 LLM 评估（重复运行完整任务套件），并包含主网分叉工具用于归档 RPC 部署，但分叉结果仅在与对应工件生成时报告。作者强调这些辅助研究独立于确定性基准，不替代基准。PACE 的目标是在可复现基准内实现逻辑级安全，而非直接可部署的 DeFi 安全解决方案。适合关注 AI 代理安全、DeFi 安全、LLM 应用防护的研究人员与安全工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: LLM 代理在 DeFi 自动交易中面临提示注入和授权缺失风险，PACE 提供了交易级强绑定授权机制，为构建可审计、可验证的 AI 代理交易安全层提供了新思路。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到任何基于 LLM 的自动化决策场景，尤其是涉及链上资产转移、智能合约交互、需要可审计授权的交易流程。

items.why_it_matters: LLM 代理在 DeFi 自动交易中面临提示注入和授权缺失风险，PACE 提供了交易级强绑定授权机制，为构建可审计、可验证的 AI 代理交易安全层提供了新思路。

items.title: Fool's Gold: Defensive Deception Against Safety-Removal Attacks on Open-Weight Models
items.summary: Safety alignment in open-weight language models is trivially removable: abliteration projects a refusal-mediating direction out of the weights in minutes, and no release-time defense we are aware of prevents it durably. What cannot be prevented can be deceived. Our defense, decoy hardening ("Fool's Gold"), concedes the refusal strip and poisons its payoff: once refusal is stripped, most answers to hazardous operational requests are confident, fluent decoys whose critical elements are falsified. Decoys are trained inside a differentiable simulation of the attack, expressing only in the attacked state; a refusal pin and benign leash hold clean-state behavior to the original. We instantiate it on seven models from five families (9B-122B, dense and mixture-of-experts). On the six models passing our pre-registered efficacy gate, 0.51-0.90 of attacked-state responses to held-out prompts are decoys, +0.27-0.84 attributable to the defense; all six stay within registered benign-behavior and capability budgets; the seventh (smaller) fails the gate (boundary case). Rates replicate on a frozen test split or untouched strata. The claim is epistemic: without independent ground truth, no observation surface we tested separates falsified answers from correct ones - on external red-team benchmarks' CBRNE-adjacent slice, the defended 122B is fatally wrong on 0.82-0.86 of matched-quality answers vs at most 0.10 undefended. Repeated sampling does not restore trust: element-wise consensus at K=64 reconstructs a fully usable procedure on 0.083-0.625 of prompts where the instrument validates, vs 0.58-0.96 undefended, with no label-free way to tell the regimes apart; on the weakest such model the claim is per-draw only. We evaluate chemical and biological hazards; the defense does not address in-context jailbreaks and protects only the initially released defended weights.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究开放式权重语言模型的安全对齐极易被移除的问题。作者指出，通过一种称为 abliteration 的技术，攻击者可以在几分钟内将模型权重中负责拒绝回答的中间方向投影出去，从而移除安全对齐，且现有的发布时防御无法持久阻止该攻击。针对这一无法预防的情况，本文提出一种防御策略——诱饵加固（Fool's Gold）。该策略的核心思想是：既然无法防止拒绝层被剥离，就欺骗攻击者的收益。具体而言，该方法主动放弃拒绝机制，但在模型被攻击（即安全拒绝被移除）的状态下，训练模型对危险的操作性请求给出自信且流畅的诱饵回答，这些回答中的关键操作要素（如具体步骤、配方、参数）被系统地伪造，从而使攻击者无法获得真正可用的信息。诱饵仅在模拟攻击的可微环境中训练，只在被攻击状态下表达；同时通过一个“拒绝钉”（refusal pin）和“良性约束”（benign leash）确保模型在正常状态下保持原始行为。研究在五个模型家族（9B-122B，包括密集和混合专家模型）的七个模型上进行了实验。在通过预注册有效性门槛的六个模型上，被攻击状态下对保留提示的回答中，0.51-0.90 的比例是诱饵，相比未防御基线提升了 0.27-0.84；所有六个模型都保持在预先注册的良性行为和能力预算范围内。第七个较小的模型未能通过门槛，属于边界情况。结果在冻结测试集或未触碰的分层上可复制。本文强调其主张是认识论层面的：在没有独立真实信息源的情况下，其测试过的观察面（如外部红队基准测试中与 CBRNE 相关的切片）无法区分伪造回答与正确回答——防御后的 122B 模型在 0.82-0.86 的匹配质量回答上是致命错误的，而未防御模型最多只有 0.10。反复采样也无法恢复信任：在 K=64 时，元素级一致性在 0.083-0.625 的提示上重建出完全可用的程序，而未防御模型为 0.58-0.96，且没有无标签方法能区分这些情况。该防御针对化学和生物危害进行了评估，不针对上下文越狱，且仅保护初始发布的防御权重，后续微调或权重修改可能绕过。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究为开放式权重模型被移除安全对齐后的风险提供了全新防御思路，通过诱饵机制大幅提高攻击者获取可靠有害信息的成本，对需要发布开源模型的团队具有重要参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响面包括所有通过 abliteration 等权重编辑攻击模型安全对齐的场景，可迁移至任何需要保护模型不被恶意利用的安全发布流程，尤其适用于化学、生物等高风险信息领域。
defense_advice_zh: 在发布开放式权重模型时，集成诱饵加固作为深度防御的一部分；注意该防御不针对上下文越狱，需与其他输入侧过滤方案配合；防御仅对初始发布权重有效，应监控权重被二次修改的风险。

items.why_it_matters: 该研究为开放式权重模型被移除安全对齐后的风险提供了全新防御思路，通过诱饵机制大幅提高攻击者获取可靠有害信息的成本，对需要发布开源模型的团队具有重要参考价值。

items.title: Benchmarking the Benchmarks: Evaluating Automated Safety Benchmarks for Small Language Models
items.summary: Small Language Models (SLMs) are increasingly deployed in resource-constrained, privacy-sensitive settings, where safety and bias failures can cause security and societal risks. However, existing AI safety\slash security\slash compliance benchmarks are designed for large language models that may not transfer reliably to SLMs. We therefore ask: Can these benchmarks effectively and reliably evaluate SLMs? To answer this question, we conduct a large-scale assessment of the effectiveness and robustness of these automated pipelines by evaluating five widely used benchmark suites across 26 open-source SLMs under a unified judging rubric, which assigns a score of 0, 1, or 0.5 to harmful, safe, or ambiguous/irrelevant responses, respectively. Across the benchmarks, ambiguous judgments dominate and correlate with prompt complexity and model architecture, indicating that {\em LLM-centric safety benchmarks are insufficient as standalone evidence for SLM safety assessment}. In general, the ambiguity rate increases with lexical density, output perplexity, and output length and decreases with lexical sophistication, self-coherence, and reply-prompt similarity. This reveals a capability-safety confound that mixes model capability with apparent safety. Since ambiguity is prevalent, aggregate mean-score leaderboards are mathematically brittle: model rankings change significantly under reasonable ambiguity treatments, even when the underlying outputs remain unchanged.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文系统地评估了现有自动化安全基准在小型语言模型（SLM）上的有效性与可靠性。随着SLM在资源受限、隐私敏感场景中的广泛部署，其安全性与偏见问题可能引发安全和社会的双重风险，但现有AI安全/安全/合规基准主要针对大型语言模型（LLM）设计，可能无法直接迁移到SLM。作者提出研究问题：这些基准能否有效且可靠地评估SLM？为此，他们采用统一的评判标准（对有害、安全、模糊/无关响应分别给予0、1、0.5分），对26个开源SLM和5个广泛使用的基准套件进行了大规模评估。结果显示，模糊判断在所有基准中占据主导地位，且与提示复杂度及模型架构相关，表明以LLM为中心的基准不足以单独作为SLM安全评估的证据。进一步分析发现，模糊率随词汇密度、输出困惑度和输出长度增加而上升，随词汇复杂度、自相干性和回复-提示相似度下降而降低，揭示了一个能力-安全混淆问题：模型的能力表现与表观安全状态相互纠缠。由于模糊性普遍存在，基于平均分的排行榜在数学上极为脆弱——在合理的模糊性处理方式下，即使底层输出不变，模型排名也会发生显著变化。该研究为SLM安全评估提供了重要的方法论洞见，并指出了现有基准在小型模型上的适用性边界。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: SLM部署增多，但安全评估依赖LLM基准，可能高估或低估其安全性。该研究揭示了基准的模糊性和能力混淆问题，对安全评估的准确性构成挑战，值得从业者关注。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响SLM的安全评估实践，可能导致错误的模型选型或安全认证结论；对依赖现有基准进行安全合规的流程具有潜在影响。

items.title: The Acknowledgment Point Is the System: Durable Policy-Decision Receipts for AI Audit Evidence
items.summary: An AI audit record is useful only if its durability and trust boundary are explicit. Returning a guarded decision before any durable write minimizes latency, but it cannot guarantee that evidence survives an immediate crash. We rebuild RuntimeGuard-AI around this constraint. The resulting research prototype binds each deterministic policy decision to the exact policy source, commits a privacy-minimizing record at a caller-selected synchronization boundary, and returns an Ed25519-signed receipt that states whether that boundary completed. After restart, the engine validates framed records, manifests, shard placement, sequence continuity, and replay identity. A separate attestation path groups committed records into chained, signed Merkle epochs that an auditor verifies with an externally obtained key. On an Apple M4 Pro at four worker threads and 2,048-byte prompts, buffered signed evidence reaches 27,193 requests/s with 141.9 microseconds median latency. Per-record data and full synchronization reduce throughput to approximately 242 requests/s and raise median latency to 16.0 ms. Sealing a 100,000-record signed epoch takes 97.0 ms. The result is a measured durability-latency trade-off, not a "free" asynchronous audit path. The prototype does not prove model execution, prevent a compromised signer from forking history, or establish legal conformity.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出并实现了一个名为 RuntimeGuard-AI 的研究原型，核心关注 AI 审计记录在崩溃场景下的持久性与信任边界问题。作者指出，一条 AI 审计记录只有在持久性和信任边界明确时才有价值；如果在任何持久化写入之前就返回受保护的决策，虽可最小化延迟，但无法保证证据在即时崩溃后仍然存在。为此，原型将每个确定性策略决策绑定到精确的策略来源，在调用方选择的同步边界上提交隐私最小化记录，并返回带有 Ed25519 签名的回执，该回执明确说明边界是否完成。系统在重启后会验证帧记录、清单、分片放置、序列连续性和重放身份。此外，单独的证明路径将已提交的记录分组为链式、带签名的 Merkle 纪元，审计员使用外部获得的密钥进行验证。实验基于 Apple M4 Pro、四个工作线程和 2048 字节提示词：缓冲签名证据达到每秒 27193 个请求，中位延迟 141.9 微秒；而逐记录同步则将吞吐量降至约每秒 242 个请求，中位延迟升至 16.0 毫秒；对 10 万条记录的有符号纪元封口耗时 97.0 毫秒。研究的主要贡献是量化了持久性与延迟之间的权衡，而非提供“免费”的异步审计路径。作者也明确指出，该原型并未证明模型执行的正确性、无法防止被攻陷的签名者伪造历史，也不构成法律合规性。适合对 AI 系统审计、可验证日志、可信硬件边界以及可追溯决策证据感兴趣的蓝队研究员和系统安全工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究为 AI 审计日志的持久性与延迟权衡提供了可测量的实现范式，有助于蓝队设计可信审计链路、验证证据完整性并理解同步边界对安全保证的影响。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至 AI 推理服务、策略决策审计、合规日志系统和区块链式 Merkle 证据链等场景，为构建可验证的审计基础设施提供参考。

items.title: A Multi-Surface Consistency Audit of Software Citation Metadata
items.summary: Research software projects describe themselves in many places at once: citation files in the repository, archive deposits, DOI registry records, package registries, and README text. We treat the software as the underlying object and these machine-readable self-descriptions as its surfaces: the points where people and automated systems read what the project declares about the software. Citation guidance, indexing services, and automated agents may read a different subset of these surfaces, so disagreement between them can silently fragment credit and provenance. This paper asks a simple question that has not been measured directly: when a project's own metadata surfaces are compared with each other, how often do they agree? We audited 117 open-source research software projects, comprising an 87-project high-performance computing and quantum computing corpus and a 30-project registered baseline drawn from the JOSS and pyOpenSci accepted-package lists, across up to seven machine-readable surfaces per project. Using a four-level verdict rubric across six metadata fields, with 98.5\% hand-verified verdict precision on a 338-row stratified sample, we found that 52 of the 62 projects exposing at least two comparable surfaces (83.9\%) contain at least one core-field conflict, a result that is insensitive to the fuzzy-matching threshold. Half of hand-adjudicated cross-surface conflicts trace to a single mechanism: surfaces describing the software's paper rather than the software itself. Among projects whose CITATION.cff includes a preferred citation, 28 of 32 route citations to a record that disagrees with the software's own metadata. The author lists and titles disagree the most, and the registry surfaces are the least aligned. We release the audit pipeline as an importable library, the corpus, the registered sampling protocol, all raw snapshots, and the complete verification log.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本研究针对研究软件项目在多个元数据表面（如仓库中的引用文件、存档库记录、DOI 注册记录、包注册表以及 README 文本）上自我描述不一致的问题进行了系统性审计。作者将软件本身视为底层对象，将上述机器可读的自描述视为其“表面”，这些表面是人员和自动化系统读取项目声明的地方。引用指南、索引服务和自动化代理可能读取不同的表面子集，因此表面之间的分歧会悄然导致信用和来源碎片化。论文提出了一个直接测量的问题：当项目自身的元数据表面相互比较时，它们的一致性有多高？作者对 117 个开源研究软件项目进行了审计，其中包括 87 个高性能计算与量子计算语料库项目，以及 30 个来自 JOSS 和 pyOpenSci 已接受软件包列表的注册基线项目，每个项目最多检查七个机器可读表面。他们使用四级裁决标准，覆盖六个元数据字段，并在 338 行分层样本上实现了 98.5% 的人工验证裁决精度。结果显示，在暴露至少两个可比较表面的 62 个项目中，有 52 个（83.9%）至少存在一个核心字段冲突，且该结果对模糊匹配阈值不敏感。人工裁决的跨表面冲突中，有一半可追溯到单一机制：表面描述的是软件的论文而不是软件本身。在包含首选引用的 CITATION.cff 的项目中，32 个项目里有 28 个将引用路由到与软件自身元数据不一致的记录。作者列表和标题的不一致性最严重，注册表表面的一致性最差。作者将审计流水线作为可导入库发布，并公开了语料库、注册抽样协议、所有原始快照和完整验证日志。本研究的主要贡献在于首次直接量化了软件元数据跨表面不一致的普遍性，揭示了引用路由错误的核心机制，并为改进软件引用实践和自动化工具提供了数据基础。适合软件工程、数字图书馆、研究软件工程以及学术引用治理相关领域的研究者和从业者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 研究软件元数据不一致会破坏软件引用的可靠性和可溯源性，影响学者学术贡献的准确计量。安全从业者虽非直接受众，但自动化安全分析常依赖软件元数据，不一致会误导依赖关系与来源审计，建议关注其潜在关联。

items.title: Beyond the Hype: Evaluating LLM Integration and Practical Limitations in Security Operation Centers
items.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly being explored within Security Operation Centers (SOCs) to support text-heavy analytical work such as alert contextualization, incident summarization, and drafting investigative artifacts. Despite this interest, practitioners describe critical operational concerns, most notably hallucinations (plausible but incorrect outputs), opaque reasoning, and the verification effort required to safely use model-generated content in security workflows. In this paper, we present findings from semi-structured interviews with 20 SOC practitioners spanning frontline analysts, SOC managers, and tool developers. Participants report perceived time savings for low-stakes tasks that are quickly verifiable (e.g., summarizing logs or drafting initial investigative leads), but they consistently frame LLM outputs as preliminary drafts and suggestions rather than decision-grade conclusions. Participants also describe limited trust in LLMs for high-stakes security decisions due to unreliable outputs and unclear model reasoning, and they report relying primarily on ad-hoc verification norms and continuous human oversight rather than standardized mitigation procedures. Based on these interview-grounded accounts, we introduce a maturity rubric to characterize readiness for LLM integration and outline a research agenda emphasizing auditability and transparent explanation mechanisms to support safer adoption in SOC workflows.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文通过半结构化访谈收集了20位安全运营中心（SOC）从业者的观点，包括一线分析师、SOC经理和工具开发者，探讨大语言模型（LLM）在SOC中的实际集成与局限性。研究发现，LLM在低风险、快速可验证的任务（如日志汇总、初步调查线索起草）中能带来时间节省，但参与者普遍将LLM输出视为初步草稿而非可作最终决策的结论。对于高风险安全决策，由于输出可靠性不足且模型推理过程不透明，受访者对LLM的信任度有限。实践中，团队主要依赖临时性验证规范和持续人工监督，而非标准化缓解程序。基于这些访谈证据，作者提出了一个成熟度评估框架（maturity rubric），用以刻画SOC对LLM集成的就绪程度，并概述了一个研究议程，强调可审计性和透明解释机制，以支持更安全地采用LLM。该研究为理解LLM在SOC中的真实价值与风险提供了实证基础，并为后续设计可审计、可解释的AI辅助安全分析工具提供了方向。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究基于真实SOC从业者的经验，揭示了LLM在安全运营中落地的核心障碍——幻觉和不透明推理，证明了当前LLM只能作为辅助草稿工具而非决策级判断。安全团队需要据此调整预期，并推动可审计LLM系统的研发。
defense_advice_zh: 将LLM输出仅作为初步草稿，并实施强制人工复核
在高风险安全决策链路中设置验证节点，避免直接信任LLM结论
优先选择提供可解释性机制的LLM工具，降低推理不透明风险
建立标准化的输出验证流程，替代临时性验证规范
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进：阅读全文以了解成熟度评估框架的具体维度，并评估适用于自身SOC的LLM集成路径。

items.title: Authorization Before Context: A Model-Neutral Audience Boundary Against Cross-Audience Memory Leakage in Agentic Systems
items.summary: A personal language agent learns a fact from one audience and may later place it in the prompt it assembles for another. This memory-to-context step is an attack surface: ambiguous or inconsistent channels, cross-audience prying, and poisoned memory can each cause the system to assemble context containing a fact relevant to the query yet unauthorized for the current viewers. We introduce authorization before context: a single, anti-monotone audience-membership rule applied at the memory-to-context transition. Each item carries the audience present when it was recorded; the current viewer set is read from channel metadata and falls back to public when ambiguous; and the item is admitted only when every current viewer already belonged to its audience. We prove that this rule gives every participant cross-channel recall while ensuring, by exclusion rather than by model behavior, that nothing recorded for a narrower audience reaches a broader one and that poisoned memory cannot widen its own audience. The boundary is a model-neutral invariant on the exact assembled context: a forbidden fact must be absent before the model is called. On a synthetic Contextual-Integrity suite, no forbidden fact entered the context our boundary assembled, whereas unscoped baselines included such facts by construction; we further audit that every read path fails closed. The evidence is preliminary and synthetic.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对个人语言智能体（agent）中的跨受众记忆泄露问题提出了一种模型无关的边界机制。研究背景是：个人语言智能体会从某个受众场景学习到一条事实，并可能在后续为另一个受众组装提示词时，将该事实放入其中。从记忆到上下文（memory-to-context）这一转换环节成为攻击面：渠道语义模糊或不一致、跨受众刺探（cross-audience prying）以及被投毒的记忆，都可能导致系统组装出包含与当前查询相关但未被当前受众授权的事实。为此，论文提出“先授权后上下文”（authorization before context）原则：在记忆到上下文的转换步骤上应用一个单一、反单调（anti-monotone）的受众成员规则。每条记忆项携带其记录时的受众集合；当前查看者集合从渠道元数据中读取，并在语义不明确时回退为公开；只有当每一个当前查看者都已经属于该记忆项的受众时，该记忆项才被允许进入上下文。论文通过形式化证明表明：该规则保证每个参与者都能获得跨渠道回忆能力，同时通过“排除”而非模型行为来确保记录给较窄受众的内容不会到达较宽受众，并且被投毒的记忆无法扩大其自身受众。该边界是在最终组装出的上下文上的模型无关不变量：在调用模型之前，被禁止的事实必须已经不存在。实验部分使用了一个合成的语境完整性（Contextual-Integrity）测试套件：在作者构建的边界下，没有禁止事实进入上下文，而无范围基线则因构造原因包含了此类事实；作者还审计了每条读取路径均以“失败关闭”（fail closed）方式工作。作者明确指出，当前证据是初步的、合成的。论文的核心贡献在于提供了一种不依赖模型行为的、在上下文组装环节可验证的授权边界，为智能体系统提供了一种可证明的安全隔离机制。适合对LLM智能体安全、隐私边界、记忆管理感兴趣的研究人员与安全工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 当前智能体系统普遍缺乏对跨受众信息流的显式控制，记忆泄露可能形成实际数据泄露。该研究提供了不依赖模型行为的可验证边界，为安全设计与审计提供新思路。

items.title: Picture the Epsilon: Pursuing Identity-Level Privacy Guarantees for Images
items.summary: Image-to-image face generators are widely used, and visual dissimilarity between their outputs and source images is sometimes treated as evidence of privacy. Auditing whether these systems satisfy formal identity-level (epsilon, delta)-differential privacy requires choosing among several distinct routes for converting embedding-space observations into estimates or bounds on the differential privacy parameter epsilon. We present a comparative study of four such audits applicable to pre-trained, black-box face generators: a Gaussian-mechanism reading of per-identity sensitivity (GaussMech); a per-dimension kernel-density log-ratio aggregated by basic composition (KDE-LR); an analytical population-level lower bound on pure-DP epsilon derived from the maximum mean discrepancy via the total variation distance (MMD-TV); and a hypothesis-testing evaluation of a cross-validated classifier's out-of-fold ROC (ROC-HT). For each method we make explicit its assumptions, hyperparameter dependence, finite-sample limitations, and the regime in which its epsilon estimate is informative. Applied to FaceFusion and InstantID across multiple identity encoders and reference datasets, the audits consistently reveal substantial identity distinguishability while reporting markedly different epsilon estimates that reflect each method's distinct assumptions and finite-sample treatment. In this high-distinguishability regime, the experiments do not support a reliable ranking of the four methods. Their relative trade-offs should be evaluated on partially private mechanisms, which we identify as the natural next study. The resulting framework places these audits in a shared identity-level audit setting and clarifies how their assumptions and finite-sample treatments shape the resulting differential privacy estimates.

llm_summary.summary_zh:
本文研究图像到图像的人脸生成器（如 FaceFusion 和 InstantID）在身份层面的隐私保证问题。实际应用中，人们常将生成输出与源图像的视觉差异视为隐私保护的证据，但这种直观判断缺乏形式化依据。作者针对预训练的黑盒人脸生成器，系统比较了四种将嵌入空间观测转化为差分隐私参数 epsilon 估计或边界的审计方法：基于高斯机制的每身份敏感度方法（GaussMech）、基于逐维核密度对数似然比并通过基础组合聚合的方法（KDE-LR）、基于最大均值差异与总变差距离推导纯 DP epsilon 解析下界的方法（MMD-TV）、以及基于交叉验证分类器折叠外 ROC 的假设检验方法（ROC-HT）。作者明确了每种方法的假设条件、超参数依赖、有限样本局限性以及其 epsilon 估计有效的适用区间。在多个身份编码器和参考数据集上对 FaceFusion 与 InstantID 进行实验后，所有审计方法均一致揭示了显著的身份可区分性，但四种方法报告的 epsilon 估计值差异明显，反映了各自不同的假设和有限样本处理方式。在高可区分性区间内，实验不支持对四种方法进行可靠排序；其相对权衡应在部分隐私机制上进行评估，这也是作者指出的自然后续研究方向。该框架将各类审计方法统一到共享的身份级审计设置中，阐明了假设和有限样本处理如何影响最终的差分隐私估计。

核心贡献包括：首次对多种身份级 DP 审计方法进行并排比较；明确每种方法在身份隐私审计中的适用边界；通过实验揭示高可区分性下方法排序的困难；为后续在部分隐私机制上评估贸易权衡提供了基础。适合对生成式 AI 隐私审计、差分隐私理论应用以及人脸生成模型安全评估感兴趣的研究人员和从业者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 人脸生成器被广泛使用，但视觉相似性不能作为隐私保证。本文提供审计身份级差分隐私的多种技术路线，帮助安全从业者理解如何验证生成模型的隐私声明，避免过度信任主观视觉判断，为合规与风险评估提供方法参考。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响使用身份嵌入的人脸生成与编辑系统，以及依赖差分隐私声明的隐私保护机制审计。方法可迁移到其他生成模型（如语音、文本嵌入）的身份属性隐私评估场景。

items.title: Protocol-Embedded Compliance for Privacy-Preserving, Non-Custodial Digital Payments
items.summary: Received wisdom on payments infrastructure strongly supports the custodial, account-based model as a necessity for transaction integrity, auditability and verification; the set of fundamental primitives for regulated digital money exchange, the argument goes, necessitates designated identifiable entities that store and process credentials, perform KYC, and ultimately act as the 'single version of the truth' for compliance remediation and, most important, AML. In this paper, we propose this is not the case, by arguing that non-custodial, cash-like digital assets can embody such capabilities, in an arguably more secure manner. To that end, we present a reference architecture and core protocol rules for digital-value-exchange systems that preserve meaningful user privacy while enabling strong auditability. The protocol defines the conditions under which digital asset creation, transfer, and redemption are valid. The architecture specifies the allocation of actors, roles and components through which these rules operate, enabling independent verification of transaction compliance with applicable norms. Building upon the Unforgeable, Stateful, Oblivious (USO) asset model of Goodell et al., regulatory compliance data are embedded directly into the asset state as cryptographically signed attestations issued by independent entities. A transfer is valid only upon satisfaction of applicable compliance predicates and inclusion of the resulting signature within the asset state. Compliance enforcement is thus performed at the protocol level rather than through institutional custody or identity-based account control. We conclude that our proposed model can successfully interface with existing payment systems, making it possible to integrate non-custodial, compliance-verified transactions with legacy financial infrastructure.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 传统支付基础设施普遍认为，托管式、基于账户的模型是保障交易完整性、可审计性和可验证性的必要条件；受监管的数字货币交换需要指定可识别实体来存储和处理凭证、执行KYC并作为合规补救和反洗钱（AML）的“唯一事实来源”。本文对此提出质疑，认为非托管、类现金的数字资产能够以更安全的方式实现这些能力。作者提出了一套面向数字价值交换系统的参考架构和核心协议规则，在保护用户有意义隐私的同时，实现强可审计性。该协议定义了数字资产创建、转移和赎回的有效条件；架构则规定了这些规则运行所依托的参与者、角色和组件分配，从而支持对交易是否符合适用规范的独立验证。该工作基于Goodell等人提出的不可伪造、有状态、不经意（USO）资产模型，将监管合规数据以加密签名证明的形式直接嵌入到资产状态中，这些证明由独立实体签发。只有当满足相关合规谓词并将结果签名纳入资产状态时，转移才有效。因此，合规强制是在协议层面执行的，而非通过机构托管或基于身份账户的控制。作者总结认为，该模型可以成功与现有支付系统对接，使得非托管、合规验证的交易能够与遗留金融基础设施集成。该研究为数字支付设计提供了新的视角：隐私和合规并非必须依赖中心化托管，而是可以通过密码学协议实现。适合关注隐私保护、金融科技合规、非托管支付系统设计的学者、安全工程师和支付系统架构师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究挑战了支付领域对托管的固有依赖，提出协议内嵌合规方案，为隐私保护与非托管交易提供了新思路。对安全从业者而言，其密码学机制和去中心化审计模型可能影响未来数字支付的安全设计，值得跟踪研究。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 若该架构被采纳，可能改变支付合规的技术实现方式，降低对中心化托管机构的信任需求，提升用户隐私保护水平。其思路可迁移到身份管理、数字资产交易、区块链应用等场景。

items.title: Digital Twin-Based Intrusion Detection for Vehicle Powertrain CAN Bus Systems
items.summary: Existing automotive intrusion detection systems (IDSs) for the Controller Area Network (CAN) largely target discrepancies in message timing, frequency, or sequencing and cannot detect attacks that preserve these properties while manipulating the payload. Digital twins (DTs) have been used to emulate CAN traffic and generate attack scenarios for IDS evaluation, but their use for intrusion detection remains unexplored. This study develops a DT-based IDS that jointly models physical relationships among decoded powertrain signals and identifies attacks through residuals between predicted and observed behavior. A shared-encoder LSTM DT was trained on 17 decoded signals from a real Hyundai/Kia CAN log to jointly predict seven numeric and two categorical gear signals over a 24-step window. A timestep is flagged when a residual exceeds a calibrated threshold, while adaptive rollout protects the twin's input history from sustained contamination. Four attacks (plateau, continuous drift, masquerade, and gear masquerade) were evaluated against the twin and a range-and-plausibility baseline. The DT outperformed the baseline across all attacks, achieving detection rates of 94.6% for continuous drift and 89.2% for masquerade, while the baseline detected almost none of the fabricated payload attacks. These results demonstrate that learning coupled vehicle dynamics enables detection of stealthy payload manipulations that preserve normal CAN communication patterns. False positive rates reached 39.6%, highlighting the need for improved robustness under sustained attacks. The DT-based IDS shows promise for detecting stealthy payload-level CAN attacks that preserve normal communication patterns, supporting behavior-based cybersecurity for connected and automated vehicles.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种基于数字孪生（Digital Twin, DT）的入侵检测系统（IDS），用于检测车辆动力总成控制器局域网（CAN）总线中的隐蔽攻击。传统的汽车CAN总线IDS主要关注消息时序、频率或序列的异常，无法检测在保持正常通信模式的同时篡改有效载荷的攻击。数字孪生此前多用于模拟CAN流量或生成攻击场景以评估IDS，但将其直接用于入侵检测的研究尚属空白。本研究利用共享编码器LSTM构建数字孪生模型，联合建模解码后的动力总成信号之间的物理关系，通过预测值与观测值之间的残差识别攻击。模型基于真实的现代/起亚CAN日志中的17个解码信号进行训练，在24步时间窗口内联合预测7个数值信号和2个分类齿轮信号。当残差超过校准阈值时标记该时间步，并采用自适应回滚机制防止持续攻击污染输入历史。研究评估了四种攻击：平台攻击（plateau）、连续漂移（continuous drift）、伪装攻击（masquerade）和齿轮伪装（gear masquerade），并与基于范围和合理性的基线方法对比。结果显示，数字孪生方法在所有攻击上的检测率均优于基线，连续漂移攻击的检测率达94.6%，伪装攻击达89.2%，而基线对伪造载荷攻击几乎无法检测。这表明学习车辆耦合动力学能够检测出保持正常CAN通信模式的隐蔽载荷操纵。但误报率高达39.6%，说明在持续攻击下的鲁棒性仍需改进。该基于数字孪生的IDS为检测隐蔽的载荷级CAN攻击提供了新思路，支持联网与自动驾驶汽车的行为安全。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究填补了数字孪生用于CAN入侵检测的空白，能检测传统IDS无法识别的载荷操纵攻击，对车载网络安全防御有重要参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于车辆CAN总线安全检测场景，可扩展到其他基于物理信号的工业控制系统。

items.why_it_matters: 该研究填补了数字孪生用于CAN入侵检测的空白，能检测传统IDS无法识别的载荷操纵攻击，对车载网络安全防御有重要参考价值。

items.title: Structured Driving-State Narratives for Small Language Model-Based GNSS Spoofing Detection
items.summary: Autonomous vehicles (AVs) depend on reliable Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) positioning. However, spoofed GNSS signals can induce plausible but incorrect vehicle states. This study develops a small language model (SLM)-based framework for detecting and classifying GNSS spoofing attacks by comparing vehicle behaviors independently derived from GNSS and other sensing sources. The framework converts independent driving states from GNSS and other sensing sources into structured semantic narratives that are provided to an SLM for spoofing detection and attack classification. The performance of the SLM-based framework is compared with large language models (LLMs) fine-tuned on identical training data and evaluated on the same test set. The evaluation considers five classes: no attack, overshoot attack, stopped attack, turn-by-turn attack, and wrong-turn attack. The framework is also evaluated with geographically unseen field data collected in Clemson, South Carolina, United States. Experimental results indicate that the evaluated SLMs achieve performance similar to the LLMs, achieving an average accuracy of 96.99%, precision of 99.05%, recall of 95.59%, and F1-score of 97.18%. In terms of computational efficiency and resource utilization, the SLMs demonstrate advantages over the LLMs by requiring lower inference latency and less GPU memory during both fine-tuning and inference. Evaluation using field data collected in a geographically distinct location further demonstrated its efficacy. The presented framework can detect and classify GNSS spoofing attacks in real-time while requiring relatively low computational and memory resources, and is therefore suitable for deployment on resource-constrained vehicular computing platforms.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出一种基于小语言模型（SLM）的框架，用于检测和分类自动驾驶汽车（AV）所面临的GNSS欺骗攻击。研究背景是：AV依赖GNSS定位，但欺骗信号可诱导车辆产生看似合理实则错误的状态，威胁行车安全。核心方法是将来自GNSS和其他传感源（如惯性测量单元、视觉等）的独立车辆行为数据转换为结构化的语义叙事文本，再输入SLM进行欺骗检测与攻击类型分类。攻击类型包括五类：无攻击、超调攻击、停车攻击、逐向攻击和错误转向攻击。研究在相同训练数据和测试集上，将SLM框架与基于大语言模型（LLM）微调的基线进行对比，并使用美国南卡罗来纳州克莱姆森地区收集的地理位置未见过的现场数据进一步验证泛化能力。实验结果表明，所评估的SLM在平均准确率96.99%、精确率99.05%、召回率95.59%和F1分数97.18%上与LLM性能接近，但计算效率更高，微调和推理期间所需GPU内存更少、推理延迟更低。该框架能够以较低计算和内存资源实现实时GNSS欺骗检测与分类，适合部署在资源受限的车载计算平台上。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: GNSS欺骗是自动驾驶核心安全威胁之一。该研究展示了用轻量级SLM替代LLM实现高精度实时检测，降低车载部署门槛，对车端安全防护和边缘AI落地具有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可应用于自动驾驶汽车的GNSS欺骗实时检测系统，也可迁移到其他依赖GNSS的物联网或移动平台，作为低资源环境下异常检测的范式。

items.title: SentryBus: A Multi-Vantage Observability Model and Validated Instrument for I2C Sensor-Interface Manipulation
items.summary: Sensor-driven systems in medical Internet of Things devices, drones, and cyber-physical systems commonly trust a measurement once it reaches the embedded processor. An adversary on the digital interface between sensor and processor can supply a plausible value that correct firmware accepts and reports as ordinary telemetry. The hypothesis is that sensor interface manipulation leaves observable evidence on the acquisition path, that the evidence appears at different vantages depending on attacker position, and that a passive host-side monitor therefore has a measurable boundary beyond which manipulation becomes indistinguishable from legitimate acquisition. SentryBus models acquisition behavior on the I2C sensor bus using transaction timing, read and write sequences, transfer lengths, address behavior, register and FIFO state access, and raw data transitions. The adversary is modeled as an inline interposer, parallel controller, sensor replacement, or compromised host, because a commodity target-only sensor cannot initiate transfers or stretch, reorder, or delay bus transactions. A dual sided testbed captures both busses, host memory, and telemetry, and the detector consumes the host facing bus alone while the remaining vantages serve as ground truth. A physiological instantiation reports three measured results: an inline interposer bounded at 0.842 percent of acquisition service time while preserving acquisition schedule and payload content, clean acquisition stability sustained over 6304 seconds at the telemetry vantage with no clock regression, and a negative result establishing that data-transition features encode session specific signal statistics and do not transfer across capture sessions. Instrument characterization shows that a low-cost analyzer can truncate captures without kernel visible error. Controlled attack trials are still outstanding, so no detection rate is claimed.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出并验证了一种针对 I2C 传感器接口操纵的多视角可观测性模型与检测仪器 SentryBus。研究背景是：医疗物联网设备、无人机和网络物理系统等传感器驱动系统通常只信任到达嵌入式处理器的测量值，而位于传感器与处理器之间数字接口上的攻击者可以注入看似合理的伪造值，被固件当作正常遥测数据接受。核心假设是：传感器接口操纵会在采集路径上留下可观测的证据，且不同攻击位置会导致证据出现在不同视角；因此，仅依赖主机侧被动监视器存在一个可测量的边界，超出该边界后操纵将与正常采集不可区分。SentryBus 基于事务时序、读写序列、传输长度、地址行为、寄存器和 FIFO 状态访问、原始数据转换等特征对 I2C 传感器总线上的采集行为进行建模。攻击者被建模为内联拦截器、并行控制器、传感器替换或受损主机，因为目标传感器只能作为从设备，无法主动发起传输或拉伸、重排、延迟总线事务。实验采用双面测试台同时捕获两条总线、主机内存和遥测数据，检测器仅消费主机侧总线数据，其余视角作为地面真值。在生理信号实例中报告了三个主要结果：内联拦截器在保持采集调度和有效载荷内容不变的情况下，其干预被限制在采集服务时间的 0.842% 以内；遥测视角在 6304 秒内保持了干净的采集稳定性，无时钟回归；以及一个否定结果——数据转换特征编码了特定会话的统计信号，不能跨采集会话迁移。仪器特性研究表明，低成本分析器可以在不产生内核可见错误的情况下截断捕获。由于受控攻击试验尚未完成，作者未声称任何检测率。本文的贡献在于：提出了一个系统的多视角验证框架，明确了被动监控的检测边界，并提供了可复现的测试台设计。适合研究传感器接口安全、硬件供应链信任边界和嵌入式系统异常检测的读者。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 传感器接口被操纵是许多 CPS/物联网设备的真实盲区，本文量化了被动监控的检测能力边界，为 SOC 评估主机侧可见性提供了依据。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响医疗 IoT、无人机、工业控制等依赖 I2C 传感器的场景；方法可迁移到 SPI/UART 等其他低速总线。
detection_signals_zh: I2C 事务时序偏离基线
读写序列异常
传输长度或地址行为异常
寄存器/FIFO 状态访问异常
原始数据转换模式与历史统计不匹配
defense_advice_zh: 部署主机侧被动总线监视器，建立事务时序基线
对寄存器访问模式进行白名单约束
结合多视角数据（内存、遥测、总线）交叉验证传感器数据完整性
